test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

As soon the gunshot was heard, people ran out in panic.
solution:
The erroneous part is option 1) i.e. 'As soon the'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in the part 'As soon the.'
 
• The given sentence contains two parts **'****the gunshot was heard'** and** 'people ran out in panic.'**
 
• Here both the incidents are happening one after another.
 
• In such cases **'As soon as'** is used as a conjunction to join the sentences.
 
• 'As soon as' is used when something happens immediately after some other event in the present and past tense.
 
• So, we need to use 'As soon as' instead of 'As soon' to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• Example:
 
 
• *As soon as the boss came to the office, everyone greeted him.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

 

Correct sentence:__ ***As soon as the** gunshot was heard, people ran out in panic.*
